objective-scoring section: explicit two-axis order policy (row order per gold ORDER BY, column order forgiven via permutations) replacing ambiguous 'order-insensitive' prose and positional comparator; aligned with taoyds test-suite eval

collapse inline SDK-version stamps into the authoritative docs/version-matrix.md rows with `see version-matrix: <fact_id>` pointers; restamp smart-selector executability to the verified 0.20.1 boundary (Traigent/traigent-skills#221; fact E per #190)
add portable audience, topic, lifecycle-stage, and maturity metadata; instructional body unchanged
add 'Two scoring lessons from a real run' section from ruler-dev-001 FINDINGS.md §3-5: column-contract failures and decline/error miscounting

headline and description now state the result as counts on the tuning slice (20/30 -> 27/30) with the selection-score caveat, the 'proven winner' section retitled 'The winner on this slice (tuning score — not a held-out result)'; new rule to execute every gold once before paying and exclude empty/erroring golds by id, result_eq no longer scores an empty gold 1.0; candidate SQL runs on a read-only handle with a watchdog; nested explicit metadata object lands one level down on 0.27.0; offline mock touches no quota; dropped the dangling 'EXAMPLE vs the REAL agent' cross-reference; references/quickstart_text2sql.md gains check_golds(), a read-only URI connection with set_progress_handler, and the empty-gold rule (verified end-to-end in --mock, exit 0). Lessons from traigent-first-run evaluation-and-dataset.md and assets/sql_structure.py.

review correction: the runnable text2SQL helper installs a default-deny SQLite authorizer before executing model-produced SQL, allowing SELECT reads and an explicit set of data-only functions while rejecting ATTACH, mutation and DDL actions, PRAGMA, and unsafe extension or filesystem functions; the connection now closes in finally, with runtime tests executing the fenced markdown helper for legitimate reads, escape attempts, and the exception path.

rebase PR #288 onto current main and sync interaction-policy v2: recommend next skills only after result-bearing steps or explicit decisions, cap recommendations at three, and attach one eligibility reason per recommendation

rebuild PR #292 on current main: teach vanilla agents to implement knobs before declaring them, require JSON-type-consistent spaces and defaults, keep evaluator metrics aligned with declared objectives, require unique example ids, and make every real walkthrough without cloud_url diagnose rejection or fallback and exit nonzero while preserving mock and linked-real success
